body.name: compressed effect operator and anchor pair
body.construction: Choose any \(V(P)\in\mathbb R^{d_x\times k}\) with orthonormal columns spanning \(\operatorname{row}[M_0(P);M_1(P)]\subseteq\mathbb R^{d_x}\), where the brackets denote vertical stacking, set \(\Delta Q(P):=\{M_1(P)V(P)\}^{\dagger}N_1(P)V(P)-\{M_0(P)V(P)\}^{\dagger}N_0(P)V(P)\), \(a(P)^\top:=m_X(P)^\top V(P)\), and \(c(P):=V(P)^\top e_1\).
